about.description: Solid World is a carbon credit tokenization platform enabling fractional ownership and trading of environmental commodities. It bridges voluntary and compliance carbon markets through blockchain infrastructure.
about.registryInfo: Solid World (Solid World Climate AG, Switzerland) is a Swiss tokenization platform for high-quality forward carbon credits. Founded 2022 by Marco De Rossi; pioneered the "pre-vintage" tokenized-carbon liquidity-pool model that aims to forward-finance carbon-credit issuance via on-chain prepayments.

fees.revenueNotes: Solid World earns origination fees on each tokenized forward and trading fees on the CRISP secondary market. Protocol-fee revenue accrues to the Solid World DAO treasury.
